system.description:
High Elf

High elves are the standard elf of the Player's Handbook and the most commonly encountered elven subrace in the surface world. Graceful and cultured, they stand between 5 and 5½ feet tall with delicate features, sharp eyes, and pointed ears. High elves are known for their mastery of sword and spell, their ancient culture, and their deep connection to the natural world. They are occasionally referred to as Moon Elves or Silver Elves.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Dexterity: +1
  • Constitution: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Resistance to Sleep and Charm: 90% immunity to sleep spells and +2 bonus on saving throws vs. charm and hold spells.
  • Detect Secret and Concealed Doors: 1-in-6 passively, 2-in-6 when actively searching.
  • Move Silently: Elves can move in near-silence in non-metal armor.
  • Weapon Proficiency Bonus: +1 to attack rolls with long bow, short bow, long sword, and short sword.
  • Woodland Stealth: Nearly invisible in woodland settings while stationary.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Magic-User, Thief; Fighter/Magic-User, Fighter/Thief, Magic-User/Thief, Fighter/Magic-User/Thief multiclass.
